seasonalEventOverrideHelp: Force a seasonal event for previewing and debugging. Manual previews ignore the event's enabled state and schedule. This only affects your browser.
seasonalEventCustomizationHelp: Customize event names, active dates, and priority. Changes are saved only in this browser.
seasonalEventPriorityHelp: Higher values take precedence when event dates overlap.
seasonalEventDateRangesHelp: The selected year is ignored and dates repeat every year. A range can cross New Year. February 29 is supported.
seasonalEventNoRanges: No active date ranges. This event will not be activated automatically.
seasonalEventStorageError: Seasonal event settings could not be saved. Check your browser's storage permissions.
